chunks.content: I am a Senior Software Engineer with 12 years old experience. Mainly I was working in Java ecosystem. But now I work mostly in Python, and I am in a transition process to become an AI/ML Specialist. Dedicated to bridging the gap between robust backend architectures and cutting-edge AI. Although I don't have any commercial experience in AI/ML, I have put a lot of effort into studying the field independently and creating some simple projects to gain practical experience. Actively seeking opportunities to develop and implement AI-driven solutions. I can start the new job in the next 2 weeks in case of B2B or next week in case of the permanent contract. One of these projects is the digital twin with which you are currently chatting. I am open to starting a job either fully remotely or in a hybrid way, with two days in the office.
chunks.title: Professional summary

chunks.content: My dream role is AI Engineer or AI Engineer Lead working on something that genuinely helps people — a product with real-world impact in a public-benefit domain. I want to work with the latest AI technologies, not just consume APIs, but actually understand how LLMs work under the hood: the architecture, the training, the inference stack. Ideally I have hands-on contact with the hardware AI runs on. I want to go deep, not just ship wrappers.
